book_aligned.definition: every window of length l+1 inside each fully unseen book, the window starts advancing by 1 token(s) (stride 1 = the exhaustive sweep the protocol asks for); no sampling, so no window-sampling noise
book_aligned.reason: The eval-set half only. The book-aligned stride-1 sweep was NOT run: Colab's T4 pool was saturated for the whole window, and the CPU cost of that sweep was measured on this 1-core host at 19.8 ms/window for the HE arm and 65.3 ms/window for the attention arm (~29 h for the six checkpoints), so it was rejected. This half was scored on the 1-core CPU host (float32, torch 2.14.1+cpu) while the training runs were on a Tesla T4 (cuda, torch 2.11.0+cu130); the recomputed eval-set means reproduce the runs' reported final held-out losses to within 3e-07, which is the float32 CPU-vs-GPU difference.
